profile.headline: Intern SWE @ Amazon | Prev. SpaceX | 11x Hackathon Winner | Congressional Award Gold Medalist

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: Amazon AWS Athena and Glue ML team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and shipped a design-review system to a 5,000+ person engineering organization. In 1 month, 165 unique engineers logged 4,000+ feedback items and 900+ comments.
• Architected the commenting stack, including a notification system, autocompleted @-mentions, file attachment previews, and editor integration. 
• Engineered an in-house patch layer over the pdf.js engine, rewriting it in TypeScript to add spatial annotation on PDF drawings and 3D models to auto-generate screenshots pinpointing flagged components. 
• Scaled distributed job dispatch to render CAD drawings on every design revision via concurrent worker queues. 
• Identified that gating the ECN process on unaddressed drawing feedback was the missing lever, working with 10+ stakeholders to drive a 10x company-wide increase in feedback resolution.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
• Researched attention dilution and developed a multi-agent architecture to enhance generation quality.  
• Created a scalable RAG database featuring real-time code indexing and semantic search for LLM context learning.

positions.title: Jr. Machine Learning Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
• Engineered advanced tool-use frameworks and vector embeddings for sophisticated code understanding.  
• Developed a multi-agent system with specialized research and implementation agents.  
• Collaborated on a Next.js (React) frontend with Langfuse integration and real-time WebSocket backend for streaming.

positions.title: AI Research Assistance
positions.locationName: Providence, Rhode Island, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Selected for Brown’s Undergraduate Teaching and Research Award (UTRA) to support AI research at Rhode Island Hospital.
• Researching LLM attention degradation and dilution, developing multi-agent systems to redact clinical records.
• Developing models for clinical text de-identification, filtering PHI from unstructured records to ensure HIPAA-compliant data use.
• Working closely with clinicians and data managers to refine system requirements.

positions.title: Project Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a full-stack AI Assistant using Nuxt.js for the frontend and Flask for the backend.  
• Implemented advanced features such as a multilingual chatbot and AI detection tool to enhance user experience.  
• Secured $10,000 in sponsorship for a dedicated machine learning server, enabling robust infrastructure.  
• Achieved national recognition with a feature in NASSP Leadership magazine, showcasing innovative contributions.

positions.title: National Honor Society Treasurer
positions.description:
• Managed finances and organized fundraising events (Hungerford, Knight-tour etc.). 
• Collaborated with board members to plan and execute community service projects, ensuring proper budget allocation and financial oversight. 
• Assisted in coordinating activities that promote academic excellence and leadership.•

positions.title: Project Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a comprehensive database system for Meridian Prep's summer programs.  
• Designed and implemented both frontend and backend systems to enhance user experience.  
• Managed a large database, facilitating higher education planning for students.  
• Developed a custom API and utilized Nuxt.js for a dynamic, responsive interface.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Nuxt.js · MongoDB · REST APIs · Serverless Computing · Mongo Atlas

positions.description: • Software development intern at woofer apparel.

honors.title: 4x Winner – HackPrinceton | 1st Capital One, 1st Knot API, Gemini, YC Runner-Up
honors.description:
- Built EdgeCart, an AI-powered food waste prevention system reducing grocery emissions by 19.5%
- Developed custom ResNet model to detect fruit freshness with Google Gemini segmentation mask
- Implemented intelligent discount matching using Knot API and xAI to target customers, cutting waste by
180M tons annually

honors.title: 1st Place – HackMIT (Cerebras Systems Track)
honors.description:
- Built tempoRoll, a music therapy system using real-time EEG monitoring for mental health conditions
- Developed hybrid CNN/ResNet brainwave classifier with Cerebras inference achieving 85% accuracy
- Integrated wireless BLE EEG communication and generated personalized music to guide brainwaves to baseline

volunteerExperiences.description: Founder and CEO of the nonprofit organization BOTSITIVITY.

projects.title: SammyGPT
projects.description: Researched and utilized advanced technologies, including 4-bit quantization, BERT, and NLP, to develop SammyGPT, an AI assistant. This multilingual chatbot, endorsed by school administration, provides up-to-date school information and includes an AI detection tool for teachers. SammyGPT supports multiple file uploads and converses in English, Russian, and Chinese. Featured in the December 2023 NASSP Leadership magazine and secured a $10,000 sponsorship for a Lenovo Machine Learning server.
